paras: 巴西各级政府采购依法必须在国家公共采购门户 PNCP 集中公示（制度依据：Lei 14.133/2021 第 174 条）。但公告数量庞大、只有葡萄牙语，中小企业每天要盯新标、盯截标日，错过截止时间就失去资格。
本站每半小时从 PNCP 公开查询 API 拉取「提案截止日在未来 14 天内」的招标，按城市、州、采购类别、采购方式、估算金额和截止时间整理成中文与英文两种清单，帮中小企业先筛出值得看的机会，再跳回官方公告核对细节。

采集——两个公开平台、免注册免 key：一是 PNCP 查询 API（pncp.gov.br/api/consulta/v1），本站每半小时拉取四个切片：未来 14 天内截止的招标、最近发布的招标、刚签好的合同、现行有效的价格登记（Ata）；二是联邦采购平台 ComprasNet 的开放数据 API（dadosabertos.compras.gov.br），补联邦机构的招标。全部返回结构化 JSON，按招标方式与状态过滤。
改写——本站不照抄官方公告的原文表述。标题由本站按「城市 + 类别 + 方式 + 截止日」原创生成，一句话简介是本站基于金额、方式、截止时间等事实字段自己写的解读；不转载正文、摘要原文，也不使用任何源站图片。
出处——每条都附 PNCP 官方详情页链接，资格要求、文件清单与投标入口以官方公告为准。
合同与价格登记不是可投标公告：合同是已成交的市场信号（谁中标、多少钱），标题明写「合同已签」；价格登记是现行有效的登记价格，中小企业可据此查看并申请参与（adesão），标题明写「价格登记」。本站把它们与在招公告分开标注，不混淆。
本站不能宣称全量覆盖：按现行规则，人口 2 万以下的小市镇可延至 2027 年 4 月 1 日才强制上 PNCP，这部分采购可能不在本站数据里。
本站展示的是未来 14 天内截止的招标中按截止时间靠前的一批，并非窗口内全部公告（2026-11-18 上线核查时，该窗口内公告超过 2.2 万条）。每日新增条数随官方发布节奏变化，本站不编造这一数字。
Staroltest，用 HOT 流水线模板搭建与维护。

Brazilian government procurement at every level must by law be published centrally on PNCP, the national public procurement portal (legal basis: Lei 14.133/2021, Article 174). But the volume is huge and notices are in Portuguese only, so SMEs have to watch for new tenders and closing deadlines every day — miss a deadline and you are out.

Every 30 minutes this site pulls tenders whose proposal deadline falls within the next 14 days from PNCP's public query API, and organises them by city, state, category, procedure, estimated value and closing time in Chinese and English, so SMEs can shortlist opportunities here and then check the details on the official notice.

Collect — two public platforms, no registration and no key. First, PNCP's query API (pncp.gov.br/api/consulta/v1), pulled every 30 minutes in four slices: tenders closing within the next 14 days, newly published tenders, just-signed contracts, and price registration records (atas) currently in force. Second, the open-data API of ComprasNet (dadosabertos.compras.gov.br), the federal procurement platform, which adds federal buyers. Everything returns structured JSON and is filtered by procedure and status.

Rewrite — nothing here is copied from the official notices. Titles are generated by this site from city, category, procedure and closing date, and each one-line summary is our own reading based on factual fields such as value, procedure and deadline. No notice body text, no original abstracts and no source images are republished.
Source — every item links to its official PNCP notice page. Eligibility rules, document checklists and submission entry points on PNCP govern.

Contracts and price registrations are not open tenders: a contract is a closed deal (who won, for how much) and is labelled “signed contract”; a price registration (ata) lists registered prices currently in force, which SMEs can check and may join (adesão), and is labelled “price registration”. They are kept clearly separate from open tenders here.

This is not full coverage of all Brazilian procurement: under current rules, municipalities with fewer than 20,000 inhabitants may delay mandatory PNCP publication until April 1, 2027, so some of their procurement may not appear here.

The site shows the soonest-closing tenders within the next-14-days window, not every notice in that window (at the launch check on November 18, 2026, the window held more than 22,000 notices). Daily new-notice counts vary with official publishing pace and are not estimated here.
